summary: Resideo Technologies filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect subsidiary ADI Escrow Issuer LLC completed a $400 million offering of 7.125% Senior Notes due 2034 to partly finance the proposed spin-off of ADI Global Distribution Inc. Proceeds are held in escrow pending spin-off closing; if conditions unmet by Dec 31, 2026, notes will be redeemed at par. Upon spin-off, escrow issuer will merge into ADI Funding, which will assume note obligations as senior unsecured guarantees. This is an escrow-backed debt financing ahead of a separation, not the spin-off consummation itself. Watch for regulatory and closing timelines; note redemption risk if spin-off fails to close.
